nc is visible" is true 3/5 of the time purely as a function of how many prior cold starts have accumulated since the app was last installed/data-cleared — a hidden, stateful dependency the test author didn't account for.

### Fix direction
Either the test should `pm clear`/reinstall before every run (forces `priorColdStarts=0`, deterministically visible), or the assertion needs to branch on the "Sync status" text (idle vs. unavailable) instead of hard-asserting the button is always present.'
